task.title: Validate the JSON document
task.shortdesc: Validate raw JSON syntax and Firefox policy values before saving.

prereq.p: Open JSON Editor with the document you want to check.

context.p: Validation distinguishes malformed JSON from policy or schema errors. A document can parse as JSON and still fail policy validation.

info.p: Expected result: the JSON document remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: If validation reports malformed JSON, fix syntax such as trailing commas or missing braces.

info.p: Expected result: the JSON document remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: If validation reports policy errors, correct unsupported keys, wrong value types, or schema-channel mismatches.

info.p: Expected result: the JSON document remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Validate again until the status explains that the document is acceptable or the remaining issue is intentional for raw review.

info.note: Saving raw JSON can change the canonical BPM profile. Validate syntax and policy values before saving.

result.p: The document has a known validation state before save or export.

postreq.p: Recovery: if errors are hard to read, use All Settings to inspect the affected policy or preference visually.
